cohort: The study included 30 pregnant women (15 with GDM and 15 with normal glucose tolerance) who chose cesarean section at Tongji Hospital.
finding: Compared to normal pregnant women, GDM patients had significantly increased placental expression of caspase-3, HIF, VEGF, and resistin, and significantly decreased placental expression of BIRC-5.
mod_finding: All participants in the study chose cesarean section.
cross-section timing: During late pregnancy (at the time of cesarean section)
